name: agent-disclosure
description: EU AI Act Article 50 readiness check: whether a page's chat tells people they are talking to an AI before or at the first exchange, and what machine-readable marking a generated image, audio, video or text file carries (C2PA Content Credentials, IPTC and XMP AI fields, a declared watermark, California's latent-disclosure fields). Runs npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/agent-disclosure locally; no account, no LLM calls of its own, files never uploaded. Not legal advice.
